title: Removing Elements from the User Interface According to Permissions

facts.text: UI elements can be shown or hidden based on user permissions to underlying tables and objects in the license.
UI elements directly related to objects via TableRelation or CalcFormula properties are automatically removed by license and permissions.
AccessByPermission property removes UI elements not directly related to objects based on user permissions to related objects.
Assign FOUNDATION permission set along with relevant permission sets for full UI Elements Removal with LicenseFileAndUserPermissions option.
Most demonstration database permission sets cannot be combined with FOUNDATION without editing to avoid blocking user tasks.
